description: This PHP source file defines the Leads module class for the vtiger CRM system, including methods for retrieving, exporting, and managing lead data and related entities.

classes.name: Leads
classes.description: CRMEntity subclass representing the Leads module, providing methods for lead data management, related record retrieval, and scoring.

methods.name: Leads
methods.description: Constructor that initializes logger, database connection, and column fields for the Leads entity.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Placeholder for module-specific operations when saving a lead.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query to export lead records based on a given condition.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves tasks and events related to a specific lead.

methods.name: get_campaigns
methods.description: Retrieves campaigns associated with a specific lead.

methods.name: get_emails
methods.description: Retrieves email records linked to a lead.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Fetches related activities with status 'Held', 'Completed', or 'Deferred' for the lead.

methods.name: get_products
methods.description: Retrieves products related to a lead.

methods.name: get_lead_field_options
methods.description: Returns options for lead dropdown fields based on a list option key.

methods.name: getColumnNames_Lead
methods.description: Returns lead record field labels for integration purposes.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from multiple leads to a target lead.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates a secondary part of a report query related to leads.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Defines relation tables for associated modules.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes the relationship link between the lead and another entity.

methods.name: getListButtons
methods.description: Returns available list view action buttons based on permissions.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Saves a relation between a lead and other modules like Products or Campaigns.

methods.name: computeLeadScore
methods.description: Calculates a lead score (0-100) based on presence and quality of certain fields.

methods.name: _leadScoreGetField
methods.description: Safely retrieves a specific field value from lead data for scoring.

methods.name: _leadScoreIsProvided
methods.description: Determines if a value should count as 'provided' in lead scoring logic.
